messages:
Maya: Quick sync on launch copy. Need three hero lanes: dev-first, infra/dedicated, private/compliance. Also a 30m webinar hook, 3 social blurbs, and simple inbound routing.

AJ: Two hero directions: "Ship LLM features in hours" (PLG) vs "Inference you can rely on at scale" (trust). Thoughts?

Noah: Use the first for Hosted/dev. Infra gets the trust line. Private gets security-focused copy. Keep <12 words.

Lina: Webinar: 30m demo + benchmark + migration checklist. Title: "From prototype to production: cost & latency playbook for inference". CTA: "Register - limited seats"

Maya: Perfect. Noah, can you draft one-line hero + subhead per lane and three social posts? Keep them short.

Noah: Drafts below. Hosted (dev): "Ship LLM features in hours. SDKs, streaming, low-lift onboarding."
Dedicated (infra): "Reserved GPU capacity with predictable SLOs and burst options."
Private (security): "Private control plane, customer KMS, audit trails for regulated workloads."

Social posts:
- Hosted/dev: "Build with LLMs, not infra. From prompt to prod in hours. Register: <link> #llmdev"
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, predictable costs. Reserve GPU capacity tuned for production. RSVP: <link> #inference"
- Private: "Inference inside your VPC — KMS, audit logs, on-prem options. Secure your deployment: <link> #security"

Lina: Routing rules (YAML) for Ops:
```yaml
source: webinar_signup
utm_campaign: q2_launch
rules:
  - if: company_size >= 500
    route: AE Enterprise
  - if: contains(tags, 'security')
    route: AE Enterprise
  - if: intent_score >= 7
    route: AE SDR-Priority
  - else:
    route: SDR
send_notifications: [sales, marketing_ops]
```

Noah: Bench blurbs for homepage cards (internal benchmark):
- "30% lower p95 latency at 2k tokens vs model X"
- "2x effective throughput on shared GPU pools with smart batching"
- "Up to 40% unit-cost reduction after prefix/KV caching"
(legal to review)

AJ: Action items:
- Noah: finalize copy + social (EOD Tue)
- AJ: build webinar landing page, wire tracking to SFDC Q2-Launch
- Lina: implement routing in Marketo/Hub, confirm notifications

Maya: Add mini-FAQ on landing: model compatibility, quantization profiles, support tiers (3 bullets each).

Noah: Example bullets ready. Uploading assets to #assets.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Launch copy review - Tue 09:30 PT (30m) - attendees: Maya, AJ, Noah, Lina

Maya: Thanks all. Closing thread, will follow up post-meeting. :tada:
